finding_info.title: Ensure Storage Account blob public access is disabled

status_detail: Storage account stprodinvoices allows public access to blob containers.
risk_details: Publicly accessible blobs can leak invoices/customer files to anyone with the URL.

remediation.desc: Set 'Allow Blob public access' to Disabled at the storage account level.

finding_info.title: Ensure no NSG allows RDP/SSH ingress from any source

status_detail: NSG nsg-app allows inbound RDP (3389) from Any (0.0.0.0/0).
risk_details: Open RDP to the internet is a common ransomware entry point.

remediation.desc: Restrict RDP/SSH rules to specific IP ranges or require a bastion/VPN.

finding_info.title: Ensure Key Vault purge protection is enabled

status_detail: Key Vault kv-ha-vnet-demo has purge protection disabled.
risk_details: Without purge protection, a compromised admin could permanently delete secrets/keys before recovery.

remediation.desc: Enable purge protection on the Key Vault (cannot be reversed once set, in a good way).

finding_info.title: Ensure MFA is enabled for all privileged (admin) accounts

status_detail: 2 of 3 Global Administrator accounts do not have MFA enforced.
risk_details: Admin accounts without MFA are the highest-value target for credential-based takeover of the whole tenant.

remediation.desc: Enforce MFA via Conditional Access for all Global Administrator roles.

finding_info.title: Ensure an activity log alert exists for policy assignment changes

status_detail: Activity log alert 'policy-change-alert' is configured and enabled.

finding_info.title: Ensure NSG Flow Logs are enabled

status_detail: Flow Logs are enabled on all NSGs in vnet-ha-demo with Traffic Analytics.
